notes: Digital TV menu boards (photos 1, 3, 4, 5) show the same core burrito/taco items at three differing price sets and slightly different item lineups, likely reflecting menu updates over time; photos 4 and 5 are exact duplicates of the same board and were merged. Photo 6 and the beverages panels (soda, alcohol, coffee) were excluded as drink-only.
